breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: periodic and Dirichlet (u=0). The agent correctly identified that the problem was periodic based on the domain specification '[0,1) periodic' and the numerical method. It correctly omitted the conflicting Dirichlet condition, aligning with the ground truth which also removed the incorrect condition.
